children: DA Davidson raised its price target on Airbnb

to $220 from $175, keeping a Buy rating. Analyst Tom White built the call on the firm's own tracking of Experiences, the tours-and-activities product Airbnb relaunched in May 2025. Airbnb shares were down 3.05% intraday.

Davidson counts listings across a set of cities and compares them against competing platforms. Experiences inventory in those markets is up 30% since May, and the firm says the growth rate is running ahead of rivals in the sector.

The street is split. BMO Capital sits at $165 and Phillip Securities cut Airbnb to Reduce at $158 on valuation, both below where the stock trades. Wedbush went the other way, upgrading to Outperform at $200. Second quarter revenue and adjusted EBITDA came in 0.8% and 2.7% ahead of consensus, and third quarter revenue guidance of $4.73 billion landed 2.7% above the Street.

title: Airbnb Stock Slips as DA Davidson Lifts Target to $220
